info.name: Vision Support Desk API
info.description: Every /api/v1 endpoint of the Vision Support Desk server. Start with **1. Auth > Login** - it saves the JWT to `{{token}}` and every request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. See postman/README.md. Requests marked [NEW] were added after the first collection.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: No sign-in needed. Use it to check the server is up.

request.description: Returns `{ data: { status: "ok", timestamp } }`.

item.name: 1. Auth (start here)
item.description: Call **Login** first. Its test script saves the JWT into the `token` collection variable; every other request sends it as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (collection-level auth).

request.description:
Email + password. Response `{ data: { token, agent } }`. The token is saved to `{{token}}` automatically and `agent.agentId` to `{{myAgentId}}`.

If `agent.mustChangePassword` is true, call **Change password** next - every other route answers 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED until then.

Wrong password/unknown email: 401. After MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS wrong passwords: 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED for LOCK_MINUTES.

exec: console.log("Token saved. Must change password:", data.agent.mustChangePassword);

request.description: The signed-in agent: role, team and the permission keys the server will enforce.
Required after a temporary password. Policy: at least 8 characters, a letter and a number, max 72 bytes, different from the current one.
Records a LOGOUT login event and clears the cookie. The token itself stays valid until it expires (JWT_EXPIRES_IN) - discard it on the client.

item.name: 2. Lookups (ids for later calls)
item.description: Run these once after login - each saves the first id it finds into a collection variable used by the ticket requests.

request.description: Support and product teams. Saves the first `Department_Id` to `{{departmentId}}`.
Optional `?departmentId=`. Saves the first `Bank_Id` to `{{bankId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("bankId", String(value)); console.log("Saved bankId =", value); }

request.description: Bank with support team, level, working days, time zone, IST support hours, 24x7 flag and resources.
Optional `?departmentId=`. Saves two active agents: `{{agentId}}` (assignee in the Assignment / Work requests) and `{{blockerAgentId}}` (the second assignee, for 'waits on').

exec: const agents = pm.response.json().data.filter((a) => a.Status === "Active" && a.Agent_Id !== pm.collectionVariables.get("myAgentId"));

request.description: `field` = STATUS | CLASSIFICATION | CATEGORY | SUB_CATEGORY | TEAM_TYPE. CATEGORY takes `parentValue` (the classification). Statuses include their `Clock_Behaviour`.
P1 / P2 / P3 and their SLA hours.
Per priority: level number and offset hours from the SLA due date (negative = before).
Every sender (Gmail) and manually created contact. `?search=` on name/email.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("contactId", String(value)); console.log("Saved contactId =", value); }

request.description: Needs tickets.create. Saves `Contact_Id` to `{{contactId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("contactId", String(value)); console.log("Saved contactId =", value); }

item.name: 3. Tickets
item.description: All need tickets.view. Create needs tickets.create; status changes tickets.edit_status; other fields tickets.edit_properties; delete tickets.delete.

request.description: Filters (all optional): `status`, `priority`, `departmentId`, `bankId`, `assigneeId`, `contactId`, `state` (open | closed | overdue), `search` (subject or ticket number), `slaBreached=true`, `closeReplies=true` (Closed tickets with a customer reply awaiting a lead), `escalationLevel` (any | 1 | 2 ...). Sort: `sortBy` (Created_Time, Modified_Time, Response_Due_Date, Priority, Status, Subject), `sortOrder` asc|desc. Paging: `page`, `limit` (max 100). Saves the first `Ticket_Id` to `{{ticketId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("ticketId", String(value)); console.log("Saved ticketId =", value); }

request.description: Manual ticket. Channel: Email | Web Form | Social | Chat | Phone. With a `bankId` the ticket goes to that bank's team. SLA due date comes from the priority on the bank's calendar. Saves `Ticket_Id` to `{{ticketId}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "subject": "Login issue on portal",
  "description": "Customer cannot log in.",
  "channel": "Phone",
  "departmentId": "{{departmentId}}",
  "bankId": "{{bankId}}",
  "contactId": "{{contactId}}",
  "priority": "P2"
}

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("ticketId", String(value)); console.log("Saved ticketId =", value); }

request.description: Full ticket with team, bank, contact, SLA due date, clock state, escalation level and counts.

Send only the fields to change: `status`, `priority`, `departmentId`, `bankId`, `productId`, `classification`, `category`, `subCategory`, `description`.

Rules: a bank moves the ticket to the bank's team; priority/bank re-date the SLA; a Closed ticket cannot go back to an open status (use Reopen); closing is refused while any assignee is not Done. The subject is fixed by design - don't send it.
Every change: event, field, old and new value, who and when.
SLA due date, time left, escalation level, holidays inside the SLA, live resolution time (support hours), reopen count.
Every mail on the ticket, in and out, oldest first.
Stores an outbound reply on the ticket (tickets.reply). It is NOT emailed - customer mail goes out from Gmail and is imported.
Never mailed. Optional `assignmentId` ties it to one assignee's work.
Saves the first `Attachment_Id` to `{{attachmentId}}`.
Returns the file (Send and Download in Postman).
Open tickets assigned to an agent.
Open tickets of one bank (board view).
Open tickets at escalation level 1 or higher. Optional `departmentId`, `bankId`, `priority`.

item.name: 4. Assignment & My Tickets
item.description: The first assignment of a ticket: Admin, Manager, Team Lead or Assistant Team Lead only. After that, current assignees can add others from any team (cross-team).

request.description: Current and released assignments with work state, who assigned, when, cross-team flag.
`agentIds`: one or more agents (here the two saved by List agents). Optional `note`.
Clears the 'new assignment' badge for the signed-in agent.
`scope` = assigned (to me) | assignedBy (me) | team (leads). `includeClosed=true` to include closed.
Counts per tab plus `unseen` (new assignments not opened yet).

item.name: 5. Work tracking
item.description: Per-assignee work. The assignee, whoever assigned them, Admin/Manager and the team leads may change it.

request.description: Per assignee and per team: time held, active, waiting and logged; swimlanes; timeline of every event; longest wait; critical path.
`state` = IN_PROGRESS | ON_HOLD | DONE. (PENDING / WAITING / READY are set by the system.)
`{{agentId}}` waits on `blockerAgentId`: becomes WAITING, then READY automatically when the blocker is Done or released. Loops are refused.
`minutes` 1-1440, optional `note`. Saves the new `Worklog_Id` to `{{worklogId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("worklogId", String(value)); console.log("Saved worklogId =", value); }

request.description: Only the person who logged it.
Ends one person's assignment. Allowed for the assignee themselves, whoever assigned them, Admin/Manager, or a lead of the ticket's team or of the assignee's team.

item.name: 6. Reply after close (reopen / new issue / no action)
item.description: When a customer mails on a Closed ticket, the mail is held (`Post_Close_Decision = PENDING`) and a lead with tickets.reopen decides. Find them with List tickets `?closeReplies=true` and put that id in `{{ticketId}}`. On an open ticket these answer 400 (reopen needs a Closed ticket; split / dismiss need a pending reply).

request.description: Pending replies after close, reopen rounds (number, reason, who, previous close/due date, SLA met) and split links.
Needs a `reason` (3-500 chars). The SLA starts fresh from now, all assignees are released, status goes back to Unassigned, reopen count +1. Works without a pending mail too (manual reopen).
No body. Creates a new linked ticket from the pending mail (properties copied - edit with Update ticket afterwards). Later replies to the old mail follow the new ticket. The old ticket stays Closed.
Marks the pending mails as no action (e.g. a thank-you). Ticket stays Closed.

item.name: 7. Recycle bin
item.description: Admin, Manager, Team Lead (tickets.delete). Deleted tickets can be restored for RECYCLE_BIN_DAYS (server .env, default 30); after that an hourly job deletes them permanently.

request.description: Admin, Manager, Team Lead (tickets.delete). The ticket leaves every list and goes to the Recycle Bin, restorable for RECYCLE_BIN_DAYS.
`{ retentionDays, tickets: [...] }` - each with Deleted_Time, Deleted_By_Name, Purge_Time, Days_Left. Saves the first ticket to `{{deletedTicketId}}`.
Back on every list as it was. 404 if it is not in the bin; 409 RESTORE_PERIOD_EXPIRED after the window.

item.name: 8. Holidays & holiday timer
item.description: Company holidays are skipped by the SLA, escalations and resolution time. Calendar endpoints need holidays.manage (Admin, Manager, Team Lead).

request.description: Optional `year`. Also returns the `applyTo24x7` setting.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("holidayId", String(value)); console.log("Saved holidayId =", value); }

request.description: Which open tickets would be re-dated if `date` became a holiday (or `remove=true` stopped being one).
Re-dates open tickets and recomputes closed resolution times.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("holidayId", String(value)); console.log("Saved holidayId =", value); }

request.description: `applyTo24x7`: do 24x7 banks also skip holidays? Default false.
Work done on a company holiday - counts in resolution time only, never the SLA. Assignee only, and only ON a holiday (other days answer 400); stops automatically at midnight IST.

item.name: 9. Customers
item.description: Gmail senders. Admin, Manager, Team Lead, Assistant Team Lead (customers.manage).

request.description: `search` (name/email), `letter` (A-Z or #), `bankId` (or `none`), paging. Each with All / Open / Closed / Overdue counts. Saves the first to `{{contactId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("contactId", String(value)); console.log("Saved contactId =", value); }

request.description: Name, email, bank and ticket counts. Their tickets: List tickets with `contactId` (+ `state`).
Same `state` buckets as the counts: open | closed | overdue (leave out for all).
Name and bank only (email is how Gmail matches them).

item.name: 10. Configuration
item.description: Reads are open to every signed-in agent. Writes: config.manage (priorities, escalation levels, picklists, products) or teams.manage (banks, teams). **These change real settings.** Each write here works on a record the folder creates first (priority {{newPriority}}, a test status, product, bank and team), then deletes it - nothing seeded is renamed or removed.

item.name: [NEW] Set SLA hours for a priority

request.description: Re-saves `{{priority}}` (P2) with its default 72 hours. Change the number only on purpose - it is the live SLA.
Offsets must increase with the level. Rebuilds open tickets' triggers. Saves `{{escalationLevelId}}`.
STATUS takes `clockBehaviour` (NOT_STARTED | RUNNING | PAUSED | STOPPED); CATEGORY needs `parentValue` (its classification). Saves `{{picklistValueId}}`.
Renaming a status moves its tickets to the new name; changing its clock behaviour applies to tickets in it.
Saves `{{productId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("productId", String(value)); console.log("Saved productId =", value); }

request.description: Saves `{{newDepartmentId}}`.
Support hours are IST HH:mm. Working days MON..SUN. Saves `{{newBankId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("newBankId", String(value)); console.log("Saved newBankId =", value); }

request.description: Changing the calendar re-dates its open tickets.
Soft delete.

item.name: 11. Agents & sign-in access
item.description: Reads: any signed-in agent. Writes: agents.manage; role changes and passwords also need admin.access. The folder creates a test agent (`{{newAgentId}}`), works on it and deletes it - no real agent is touched.

request.description: Optional `roleId` (from Admin > List roles). No sign-in is created - set a temporary password next. Saves `{{newAgentId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("newAgentId", String(value)); console.log("Saved newAgentId =", value); }

request.description: `status: Inactive` blocks sign-in and closes their sessions.
admin.access. The agent must change it at first sign-in. Also clears a lockout. Put the value in `{{tempPassword}}`.
admin.access. Removes the agent's sign-in; existing tokens stop working.
Soft delete; sign-in revoked.
With their permission keys. Saves the Team Member role's id to `{{roleId}}`.

exec: if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set("roleId", String(value)); console.log("Saved roleId =", value); }

request.description: Every permission key with label and description.
Replaces the role's whole permission list (takes effect on the next request; the Admin role is locked). The body is the Team Member default - change it only on purpose.
Agents with sign-in state: has password, must change, locked, last login.
Latest sign-ins, failures (with reason) and logouts.
Mailbox, connected, sync interval. Never returns secrets.

item.name: 13. Gmail integration
item.description: Admin only (admin.access) except the OAuth callback, which Google calls.

request.description: Open the returned URL in a browser and sign in as GMAIL_MAILBOX.
Google redirects here. Shows the refresh_token to put in server/.env as GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.
Imports new mail now (the background job does this every GMAIL_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS).
Hides mail deleted in Gmail and restores mail taken back out of Trash.
